name: GitHub & GitHub Enterprise
covers: Pull requests, reviews, issues, projects, checks
credentialNote: In GitHub Actions, GITHUB_TOKEN and GITHUB_API_URL are used when no toil token or base URL is set
credentialWhere: Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained tokens

supported.api: REST API 2022-11-28 and the GraphQL API
supported.note: toil pins REST API version 2022-11-28 and uses GraphQL for review threads, PR status, auto-merge, the merge queue, drafts and Projects. GitHub.com is always current; no Enterprise Server release has been verified yet. The auto-merge and merge-queue commands need a release that has those features, and so do issue types, sub-issues and Projects (v2); a release without sub-issues or Projects gets UNSUPPORTED.
